name: Advanced Filesystem: Smart Image
description: On-demand, adaptive image derivative generation with a plugin-based transformation pipeline, HTTP caching, signed URLs, presets, and Drush CLI tools. Works like Imgix/Cloudinary — fully inside Drupal.

suggests.ext-gd: PHP GD is mandatory at runtime — the /adfs/image endpoint returns HTTP 500 without it. libwebp/libavif enable WebP/AVIF output.
suggests.drush/drush: ^12 — enables the adfs:image:* CLI commands (derive, prebuild, warmup, purge, stats, token).

project_description: Advanced Filesystem: Smart Image is a submodule of Advanced FileSystem that turns Drupal into a self-hosted, Imgix/Cloudinary-style image service. A single anonymous-accessible endpoint, /adfs/image, generates image derivatives on demand from a source stream-wrapper URI plus query parameters (width, height, fit mode, focal point, crop gravity, padding, quality, output format, rotate/flip, filters and watermark). Transformations run through a weighted ImageTransform plugin pipeline built on PHP GD (resize/crop, pad/border, rotate/flip, pixel filters, watermark), and results are cached to a two-level derivative directory on the public filesystem with immutable Cache-Control, ETag/Last-Modified and 304 support. Output format can adapt to the client's Accept header (auto → AVIF/WebP/JPEG) and quality can be chosen per format. A Twig extension adds |adfs_image, |adfs_srcset, |adfs_blurhash and |adfs_lqip filters so templates can emit responsive markup and placeholders without hand-building URLs. Named presets bundle common parameter sets. Optional HMAC-SHA256 URL signing can require a token query parameter. Drush commands pre-generate, warm up, purge and inspect the cache, and cron prunes derivatives older than a configurable age.
